card.name: Words just before 'partial'
card.fires_on: Linking words or punctuation (like 'or', 'and', a comma, 'only', 'for') right before the word 'partial' or 'partially' is expected, e.g. 'partial thromboplastin time' or 'partial-onset seizures'.

modes.label: Before 'partial' terms
modes.description: A comma, 'and', 'or' or 'for' directly ahead of a term beginning with partial.
modes.example: Mixed Agonist/Antagonist<< and>> Partial Agonist Opioid Anal

modes.label: Hedged degree wording
modes.description: Words like 'either' or 'only' that set up 'fully or in part' or 'partial recovery'.

card.writes: It raises 'par' beginnings and lowers 'partial' forms, so it acts against the predicted word 'partial'.
card.plain: It lights up on the small word just before 'partial' is likely to appear, as in 'partial thromboplastin time'.
